id.description: Stable identifier, matches the 3D model node and OSM way ID where available

name.description: Display name; may be empty for unnamed structures

footprint.description: Polygon vertices in world coordinates [x, z]

height.description: Estimated or measured height in meters

style.description: Template key from the building composer, e.g. hip_roof_gable_dormer

material_hint.description: Visual cue for low-fidelity renderers: brick, vinyl, wood, stone

adjacent_roads.description: IDs of roads touching this footprint

canon_ref.description: Path into the canon layer for this building's history, if any

confidence.description: 0 = style template only, 1 = verified against aerial and ground truth

source.description: Where the data came from: osm, aerial, composer, manual
